# Vision

The Tool Library serves the members of one neighbourhood. A member needs a tool for a short job and does not want to buy it.

The system lets a member reserve a tool and lets the desk record each loan. The outcome is that each tool is used more often and each member spends less.

Delivery of tools and payment are out of scope.
